identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-H.6] Prove v3 with real issue canaries and update operator readiness docs

values.task_boundary: Prepare and execute the V3-H.6 canary/docs/readiness lane without merging #505 or claiming v3 live authority.
deliverables: V3 real issue canary evidence index
Defect register with fixed, follow-up, or cutover-blocking disposition
Docs, skills, AGENTS, and onboarding updates for the v3 cutover boundary
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every v3 command-equivalent route is exercised by a real issue canary, a focused deterministic fixture, or an explicit cutover-blocking finding.
AC-2: At least one real issue reaches PR through v3 before #505 closes.
AC-3: Terminal finish and cleanup are proven after an authorized canary merge, or #505 remains blocked with the exact reason.
AC-4: All found defects are fixed in-sprint or recorded as cutover blockers/follow-ons with ownership.
AC-5: Docs and skills do not teach v2 as the future route after cutover, and do not teach v3 as current authority before #505.
AC-6: Final sprint review packet is ready for independent exact-head review.
AC-7: No raw gh lifecycle writes and no hidden v2 operational fallback are used as proof.
dependencies: #627 command denominator and one-binary CLI shell
#631 proof, parity, soak, shadow, and install routes
#505 final cutover decision remains open until proof is complete
non_goals: Do not retire v2 authority in this issue
Do not perform raw gh lifecycle writes
